sample.task:
(In the Horde city of Orgrimmar, 100 years after the still ongoing peace treaty between the Horde and Alliance started…)

Gervivien: “Okay, you two little kickers…settle down now. Mommy’s off to school.”

(Gervivien’s parents - who are also nightborne and experienced hunters - approach her.)

Parents: “Good morning, Gervivien. Have a great day at school. Remember to pay attention and listen to your teachers.”

Gervivien: “I will, Mom and Dad. Don’t worry. I’ve been studying hard for my lessons.”

Mother: “That’s my girl. We’re proud of you, Gervivien. Just be careful and stay safe.”

Father: “We trust you, but remember, if anything doesn’t feel right, don’t hesitate to use your abilities and find a quiet, safe place until we can come to get you.”

Gervivien: “I know, Dad. You’ve taught me well. I’ll be cautious and aware of my surroundings.” (feeling another kick from the twins) “Oh!”

Mother: “Is everything okay, Gervivien?

Gervivien: “Yes, Mom. It’s just the twins kicking again. They’re quite active today. I just don’t know why. I didn’t want to be a mother - let alone to twins.”

Father: “It’s normal for them to be active, Gervivien. They’re growing and getting ready to come into the world. You’ll be a great mother to them, I promise.”

Mother: “It’s natural to feel overwhelmed sometimes, especially with two on the way. But they’re a blessing, Gervivien, and we know you’ll love them and take care of them.”

Gervivien: “I know, Mom, it’s just…I never imagined this would happen to me. Being a mother was never part of my plans, especially with all the tensions between the Horde and Alliance.”

Father: “Life has a way of surprising us, my dear. And despite the differences between the factions, we’ve lived in peace for a century now. We’ve managed to forge relationships and build families, even across those boundaries.”

Mother: “You’re right, Gervivien. Our family is proof that there can be unity and love among different races and factions. Your children will be a part of that unity.”

Gervivien: “I hope so, Mom. I want them to grow up in a world where they’re not judged by their race or faction but by who they are as individuals.”

Father: “And we’ll do our best to raise them that way. They’ll embrace their nightborne heritage, of course, but they’ll also learn to appreciate others and work towards a future of understanding and harmony.”

Gervivien: “I believe in that future, Dad. And I promise to do all I can to make it a reality, not just for my children, but for all those who come after us.”

Mother: “We’re so proud of you, Gervivien. You have a big heart and a strong spirit. And with that, you can truly make a difference in this world.”

Gervivien: “Thank you, Mom, Dad. Your support means everything to me. Now, I better go off to school. I don’t want to be late.”

Father: “Take care, Gervivien. We’ll be here waiting for you when the day is done.”

Mother: “Good luck, my love. We know you’ll shine bright.”

(Gervivien takes a deep breath, feeling a mix of excitement and nerves, and heads off to school, knowing that no matter what challenges lie ahead, she has her loving parents by her side and the hope of a better future.)

(At school, Gervivien runs into her newest classmate from the Horde - a goblin mage named Lexia.)

Gervivien: “Hey there, you must be my new classmate, right? I’m Gervivien. Nice to meet you!”
sample.chosen:
Lexia: *smiles and extends her hand for a handshake* "Hi Gervivien! Yes, I'm Lexia, the new goblin mage in town. It's great to meet you too! I've heard a lot about you from our teachers. They say you're one of the most promising students here."

Gervivien: *blushes slightly* "Oh, thank you, Lexia. That's very kind of you to say. I'm just trying my best, like everyone else. So, what brings you to Orgrimmar? I don't see many goblins around here, especially not in our school."

Lexia: "Well, my family has been part of the Horde for generations, but we've always been more focused on trade and engineering. However, I've always been fascinated by magic and its potential to bring people together. When I heard about the peace treaty and the opportunity to study here, I couldn't resist. I want to learn from the best and hopefully contribute to the unity between the Horde and Alliance in my own way."

Gervivien: "That's amazing, Lexia! I share the same hopes for the future. It's wonderful to see more and more people from different races and factions coming together to learn and grow. I believe that understanding and cooperation are the keys to a peaceful and prosperous world."

Lexia: "Absolutely! And I'm excited to learn from you and the other nightborne here. Your people have such a rich history and connection to magic. I'm sure there's a lot I can learn from you."

Gervivien: "I'm sure there's a lot we can learn from each other, Lexia. I'm looking forward to working together and seeing what we can achieve. Shall we head to class? I think our first lesson is about to start."

Lexia: "Yes, let's go! I can't wait to see what today's lesson has in store for us."

(The two new friends walk side by side, eager to learn and grow together, symbolizing the unity and hope for a better future between the Horde and Alliance.)
